principle: No Doré exploration result may remain chat-only. Every finding must be assimilated into deterministic core behavior, learned into design intelligence, mounted as a replaceable tool, or explicitly deferred with a reason.

absorption_modes.assimilate: deterministic capability becomes Doré-owned contract/logic; provider implementation remains replaceable
absorption_modes.learn: design grammar, judgment or data-model insight becomes reusable Design Intelligence knowledge, never copied styling
absorption_modes.mount: mature external tool is invoked behind a Doré adapter/router and loaded only when needed
absorption_modes.defer: kept as researched evidence with an explicit trigger for reconsideration

italian-editorial.rule: Every observed editorial discovery must record target + why + absorption mode. Deferred observations must also record reconsider_when.
italian-editorial.authority_boundary: Italian references are evidence and teachers, never Westside visual authority.
italian-editorial.canon_threshold: No single issue, page, studio, era or publication may directly create Westside canon. Repetition across evidence plus successful Westside real-surface use is required.

findings.why: empty space can carry hierarchy, anticipation, sacred stillness and editorial pressure; it must never be treated as leftover blank area
findings.boundary: whitespace is admitted only when compositionally intentional and beautiful

findings.why: image and type relationships should create controlled visual gravity rather than merely fill a grid
findings.boundary: do not copy magazine layouts

findings.why: repeatable editorial relationships can compile into deterministic layout primitives
findings.boundary: grammar is reusable; reference-page geometry is not

findings.why: content should appear with a reasoned editorial rhythm before an animation engine is selected
findings.boundary: motion remains subordinate to content and composition

findings.why: learned editorial emergence can become structured semantics such as stillness, threshold-opening, ceremonial-reveal and weighted convergence
findings.boundary: never compile an observed magazine effect into a literal copied animation

findings.why: editorial character often comes from proportional type relationships, measure, leading and hierarchy rather than decoration
findings.boundary: Westside font identity remains authority

findings.why: materiality changes perceived depth, silence, warmth and editorial character and should be understood before effects are applied
findings.boundary: material is meaning, not a filter preset

findings.candidate: visual rule observed in only one reference
findings.why: a striking single-page decision may be contingent rather than a reusable grammar
findings.reconsider_when: the same relationship recurs across multiple independent issues/eras/studios or a Westside real-surface repeatedly needs it
findings.boundary: never promote a single-reference observation directly into canon

findings.why: unstyled accessible primitives with visual authority left to Westside
findings.boundary: never import default aesthetic

findings.why: accessibility, input modality and internationalization substrate
findings.boundary: behavior-only

findings.why: learn source ownership and registry distribution; do not inherit its house style
content/container driven responsiveness instead of breakpoint accumulation
findings.boundary: compile to browser-native CSS where sufficient

findings.why: learn compilation from composition specification to deterministic CSS Grid/Flex
findings.boundary: Westside 5:8, brick, battlement and flow remain authority

findings.why: exact geometry should be solved, not guessed by a model
findings.boundary: solver may satisfy geometry but never choose visual meaning

findings.why: compile hierarchy, measure, leading, tracking and fluid scale into stable rules
findings.boundary: font identity remains Westside canon

findings.why: multiscript Chinese/Latin/Greek/Hebrew shaping and publication-time font intelligence
findings.boundary: do not ship shaping runtime to normal pages when browser shaping suffices

findings.why: derive usable relationships from canonical colors without replacing canonical colors
findings.boundary: canonical Westside colors are authority

findings.why: separate image generation from crop, focal point, bleed and responsive use
findings.boundary: art direction does not alter source identity

findings.why: deterministic responsive variants, crop, format conversion and compositing
findings.boundary: no runtime image dependency when static materialization suffices

findings.why: semantic intent first, lowest sufficient engine second
findings.boundary: stillness is first-class; reduced motion mandatory

findings.why: keep as escalation weapons only after native insufficiency is proven
findings.reconsider_when: a real accepted surface requires choreography unavailable natively

findings.why: one structured composition can materialize across web/social/poster/publishing surfaces
findings.boundary: artifact compiler is not visual authority

findings.why: one canon can compile surface profiles instead of maintaining parallel CSS worlds

findings.why: design should be structured data rather than screenshot-only evidence
findings.boundary: Figma remains current master surface; no tool migration implied

promotion_rule: A weapon becomes canonical only after deterministic acceptance plus real-surface evidence where visual quality is relevant.
